subject: Deep learning hardware, could somebody write a message to them to finance the adaptation of Stan

messages.author: 71c315ee557ff234
messages.subject: Deep learning hardware, could somebody write a message to them to finance the adaptation of Stan
parts:
Dear all,

I remembered when Intel couldn't sell enough of their CPUs, because memory was too
expensive, so they supported them.
Nowadays, we all have this nice hardware, which helps to do "deep" learning. But
wouldn't be nice if they would support the adaptation of Stan and sell 
more hardware? Don't they see the potential of Stan? Most biological, pharmacy,
chemical could use it, but nowadays Stan is too slow on CPU for some
"real" world problems.

Andre
